Partnership options

Two ways to partner with SENSORA 2027.

01

Headline Partner

  • Naming rights: “SENSORA in partnership with [Brand]”
  • Lead partner exclusivity

02

Experience Partner

  • Exclusive category partner, embedded across the night
  • On-menu or in-room credit
  • Shared screen rotation, printed materials and verbal acknowledgement
  • One premium hosted table (10 guests)
  • Short-form content with 7FIFTY
